DimeNet++ Weekly Progress

Ethanol CCSD(T) · Gold-only · Dongxiao · September 24, 2026

Interim training snapshot: 144/200 epochs completed. Selected epoch so far: 144. Training was still running when this report was generated. This page is a fixed snapshot, not a live monitor.

What changed since last week?

Last week: Completed the 100-epoch baseline and its final test evaluation.

This week: Added error diagnostics and performed additional training beyond epoch 100 in a controlled 200-epoch experiment. The first 100 epochs reproduced the earlier run exactly.

Same architecture, Gold train/validation splits (889/111), seed 42, learning rate 0.0001, and loss weights. The changed factor is training budget. The run restarted from the same initialization because the old checkpoint did not include optimizer state.
